name: Fisher Brigga
title: The Kingshore
examine: Salt-and-weather hands and a stare that carries clean across the mere. She rows further out than anyone on the Kingshore, and trades what she learns of the far banks very carefully.
lines: The mere gives. The mere is thanked. You skip the second part, the first part gets complicated.
There are fires on the far water some nights. Croaking, if the wind's right. We wave. They wave. That's the whole treaty and it's held longer than most.
Holm fishes the reeds and I fish the deep, and we've argued which is braver for thirty years. It's the reeds. Don't tell him.
